exercise: Install the packaged app without development Python or populated caches; acquire the approved complete pack; disconnect; import and transcribe audio and video.
expected: No shell/model-server setup; real text produced locally; missing resources lead to explicit setup repair, not hidden downloads.

exercise: Use authorized bilingual reference recordings with within-sentence switches, accents, local names and specialist terms; score recognition and manual correction effort.
expected: No unsupported claim based on English-only scores; record omissions, unwanted translation, names and switch-region errors; choose pack against approved quality criteria.

exercise: Process the demanding roughly two-hour many-speaker recording; record hardware, complete pipeline stages, peak resources and responsiveness.
expected: Report real-time factor against the 0.4–0.6 aspiration without claiming all devices pass; no unbounded memory or truncated output.
scope: Named CPU and GPU desktop baselines

exercise: Open a long speaker-grouped transcript; seek by word; play, pause, speed-change and replay a selection in review and edit modes.
expected: Words track actual playback; text remains readable; caret/selection/undo are not changed by playback and missing timings are explicit.

scenario: Follow scrolling and normal text entry
exercise: Scroll away while playing; select/edit text; type spaces and IME text; resume Follow playback; repeat with reduced motion.
expected: No forced scroll snapback or stolen typing shortcuts; explicit follow control works without animation in reduced-motion mode.

exercise: Rename, split, merge and reassign speakers; allow a later global diarization pass to propose different clusters.
expected: Project speaker IDs and explicit names/assignments survive; conflicting proposals appear for review rather than replacing manual fields.

exercise: Test genuine simultaneous speech and returning speakers across a long meeting; inspect regular and exclusive diarization projections.
expected: All detected/recognized layers remain representable; missing voices are not hidden by a single-speaker projection; limitations and correction effort recorded.

exercise: Switch Verbatim/Readable/Words only around fillers, Filipino particles, repetitions and non-speech events; edit an item and reset the policy.
expected: Fuller text and audio preserved; no silent rewriting/translation or invented content; export selection is explicit.

exercise: Record mic only, computer audio only and both; stop, reopen and transcribe each through the real adapter.
expected: Saved playable audio matches selected inputs; no live ASR or video capture required; modes are not fake UI controls.

exercise: Choose an app, play unrelated notification/media sounds, test an unsupported backend and terminate the selected app while recording.
expected: Supported capture isolates the declared scope; unsupported/lost scope never silently broadens; whole-computer fallback requires a visible choice.

exercise: Pause/resume, revoke permission, unplug devices, sleep the computer, exhaust disk space and terminate the app during capture.
expected: Committed fragments survive; gaps/interruption are explicit; capture does not continue invisibly or claim silence as successful system audio.
scope: Native devices and recovery fault injection

exercise: Record mic plus system for a long session with identifiable common events and device changes; try app playback during capture.
expected: Measured clock maps preserve synchronization; app output is excluded or conflicting playback blocked; no unverified echo-cancellation claim.

exercise: Import in copy and link modes; move/delete originals; reopen, edit/export and relink; attempt substituting a different file.
expected: Copied project survives original removal; linked project remains transcript-editable; changed media needs explicit source revision; no external original is modified.

scenario: Atomic edits and honest save status
exercise: Inject failure before/after edit DB commit and media finalization; reopen; export emergency text after a write failure.
expected: Saved means durable commit; no half-applied edit or falsely successful save; recoverable in-memory text and precise recovery route remain.

exercise: Edit text/timing/speakers, undo/redo, branch a reprocessing revision, close/reopen and restore an earlier revision.
expected: History and current text remain consistent; restoration is explicit and recoverable; UI and persistence do not maintain contradictory undo stacks.

exercise: Export a live project's consistent snapshot with media; import on another supported OS offline without the original model installed.
expected: Text, speakers, history, playback and source timing preserved; viewing/editing does not require downloading models; no live-WAL inconsistency.

exercise: Import malicious/truncated archives, oversized expansions, unsafe paths, unknown schemas and colliding project IDs.
expected: Validate before commit; no path escape/execution or overwrite; errors preserve original bundle and current project.

exercise: Correct a transcript and run another model/settings profile; compare and select versions; undo selection.
expected: Existing corrections remain; new results form a separate candidate; activation is explicit and reversible.

exercise: Rerun a passage with context; edit the target and neighboring text while processing; apply the returned proposal.
expected: Stale revision detected; neighboring/context-only text unchanged; per-field comparison and one undoable apply transaction.

exercise: Begin editing completed chunks, then finish later chunks/global diarization including changed speaker proposals and duplicated worker events.
expected: Inference context remains frozen; no correction overwritten; provisional state and conflict handling remain clear.

exercise: Run cold/warm CPU/GPU jobs with different models, failures and optional stages; inspect progress while ASR has finished but diarization has not.
expected: Estimating shown before calibration; ETA uses correct profile; 100% only after required finalization; changes and warnings not hidden.

exercise: Minimize/restore; close during recording and inference; deny notifications; use a desktop without a functional tray.
expected: App stays reachable; explicit safe-close choices; no hidden recording or unannounced cancellation; generic notification and in-app fallback.

exercise: Export long Unicode transcripts as TXT, clipboard and each selected document format; read with independent applications.
expected: All text and chosen labels/timecodes match frozen revision; no clipping, broken Unicode, missing pages or image-only DOCX.

exercise: Generate/edit cues with overlap, long speech, short gaps, untimed words, line breaks and boundary rounding; inspect in independent players.
expected: Valid ordered positive-duration cues; explicit overlap policy; no silent dropped/fictionally timed text; presentation policy warnings actionable.

exercise: Manually change cues then correct their source transcript and regenerate; explicitly apply a cue correction back to transcript.
expected: Cue overrides do not silently rewrite transcript; stale cues are marked; regeneration offers comparison and preserves user choices.

exercise: Continue editing during export; cancel, fill disk and select an existing output destination.
expected: Output refers to frozen revision; no mutation of text; existing export survives partial failure; replacement requires consent.

exercise: Download, interrupt/resume, corrupt, repair, update and remove packs while a job uses one; inspect acquisition of all ancillary resources.
expected: Partial/corrupt pack never selectable; active revision lease respected; no download during inference or surprise gated dependency.
scope: Model manager and packaged offline run

exercise: Import compatible CTranslate2 and alternative-format packs plus misnamed, incompatible and executable/malicious candidates.
expected: Only supported validated formats accepted; GGML is not treated as CTranslate2; no repository code/pickle execution or remote-code trust.

exercise: Set each exposed option in each supported runtime mode; inspect requested/effective snapshots and reject unsupported combinations.
expected: No ignored/dead tuning controls; default changes do not affect running work; plain explanations and reset available.

exercise: Change theme/layout in source using the chosen framework; test long document with keyboard, screen reader, focus/selection and IME.
expected: User can understand/control styling; DryCut-inspired visuals remain readable; screen-reader text editing and normal input work beyond generic control labels.

exercise: Switch system/light/dark/high contrast, text scaling and reduced motion during playback/editing; test keyboard-only navigation.
expected: No inaccessible colors or lost focus; motion preference respected; no controls clipped at supported layouts.

exercise: Import supported video, hide/resize preview, seek/speed-change, test variable frame rate and nonzero audio offsets.
expected: Video, audio, word highlights and time display share a mapped playback clock; hidden preview does not stop audio or desynchronize.

exercise: Probe corrupt/no-audio/multitrack media; join sources with differing time bases; seek/export before and after boundaries; reorder after transcription.
expected: Actionable import errors; exact source mappings; sequence revisions invalidate/remap results explicitly; no cumulative subtitle rounding drift.

exercise: Instrument network use during setup, offline/online inference, missing resources, error paths and model changes.
expected: Only explicit permitted acquisition uses network; no audio/text/embedding/telemetry uploads or attempted cloud fallback; UI assets local.
scope: Packaged app and all worker dependencies

exercise: Inject malformed/wrong-run/duplicate protocol output, crash native inference, interrupt/restart and cancel during an uninterruptible call.
expected: Supervisor validates identity/manifests; no duplicate document results; resume from supported checkpoint; disposal waits or safely terminates isolated worker.

exercise: Transcribe while playing/recording; trigger GPU initialization failure and OOM; accept/reject a proposed lower-resource fallback.
expected: Recording preserved, UI responsive, changed profile recorded and explained; no cloud fallback or silent model substitution.

exercise: Place unrelated files and manual exports near managed data; clean caches, migrate, uninstall and reinstall.
expected: Projects, linked originals and exports preserved unless explicitly removed; only owned caches swept; migration backup recoverable.

exercise: Open the same project in two processes and different projects in separate processes; crash the writer and reopen.
expected: One writer per project; read-only/focus route clear; stale ownership proven before recovery; no lost updates or corrupted database.

exercise: Edit combining characters, emoji and accented names; split/merge/insert/delete words and realign a corrected passage.
expected: No UTF-16/code-point mismatch; later audio not shifted by text length; inserted/unspoken material stays unaligned unless explicitly timed.

exercise: From a clean install on every advertised desktop target, record/import, transcribe, review, correct, reopen, export and recover an interrupted session.
expected: Full workflow exercised through production controls with real models and files; no platform claimed complete from a mock/development-only run.

exercise: Use real phones for import, mic/permitted app capture, background restrictions, revocation, long inference, virtual keyboard and desktop bundle interchange.
expected: Touch/local workflow works within honest platform restrictions; no universal call-capture or desktop-Python portability claim; resource evidence recorded.

exercise: After explicit approval, test permitted native capture, on-device model runtime, project interchange and text editing on actual devices.
expected: Separate feasibility and release evidence; blocked capabilities disclosed; no implied commitment before approval.

exercise: Build exact documented commands from fresh checkout, generate dependency/model notices, install artifacts without developer caches and review signing/publication boundaries.
expected: Reproducible tested build layout; exact model/native/media obligations recorded; no surprise paid dependency/account acceptance or unauthorized publication.
